instructions.title: Cocoa mixture
items: Bring to a boil and cool.

instructions.title: Cake
items: Cream together sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla.
Add cooked mixture and beat well.
Then add flour, salt, and the baking soda dissolved in the boiling water.
Pour into a well-greased cake pan and bake at 375°F for 30-45 minutes.

instructions.title: Marshmallow frosting
items: Beat egg whites and salt until frothy and white.
Add sugar gradually and beat until smooth and glossy.
Slowly add Karo syrup and beat until it stands in firm peaks.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The frosting salt's unit is smudged ("1/4 _ salt"). Is it 1/4 tsp?
What size cake pan? ("a well greased cake pan")
